name: comp-462
title: Full Ellipsis Pagination
blurb: Pagination with full range ellipsis display.
description: Pagination showing full page number range with ellipsis on both sides of current page.
use_when: Large pagination sequences with detailed page visibility around current position.
avoid_when: Small result sets or when compact pagination is needed.
a11y: Semantic pagination with full page number display and ellipsis indicators.
